rationale: The agent verified the user’s identity via email, located the correct account, and retrieved order details. It identified the delivered order containing the T-shirt, checked available product variants, and proposed an appropriate smaller, black, cotton, crew-neck option. The agent explicitly stated the exact change and price difference, specified the payment method, and obtained the user’s confirmation before executing the exchange. It then performed the exchange using the correct tool and confirmed the outcome with accurate details. A minor inaccuracy appeared when listing “smaller size” options (including a black XXL), but it did not affect the confirmed exchange action. No unauthorized actions, fabricated details, or missing confirmations were observed.
